00044 PinkNoiseUGenInternal::PinkNoiseUGenInternal() throw()
00045 :   UGenInternal(NoInputs),
00046     //random((unsigned int)this * 123463463UL + 423815L + rand(19469146))
00047     random(rand(0x7fffffff))
00048 {   
00049     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00050     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00051     
00052     for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) 
00053     {
00054         unsigned long r = Ran088::next(s1, s2, s3) >> 13;
00055         total += r;
00056         dice[i] = r;
00057     }   
00058     
00059     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00060     
00061     initValue(random.nextBiFloat());
00062 }
00063 
00064 void PinkNoiseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00065 {
00066     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00067     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00068     
00069     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00070     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00071     
00072     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00073     {
00074         unsigned long counter = Ran088::next(s1, s2, s3);
00075         unsigned long newrand = counter >> 13;
00076         int k = Bits::countTrailingZeros(counter) & 15; 
00077         unsigned long prevrand = dice[k]; 
00078         dice[k] = newrand; 
00079         total += (newrand - prevrand); 
00080         newrand = Ran088::next(s1,s2,s3) >> 13;
00081         Element val;
00082         val.u = (total + newrand) | 0x40000000;
00083         *outputSamples++ = (val.f - 3.f);
00084     }
00085     
00086     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00087 }
00088 
00089 PinkNoise::PinkNoise() throw()
00090 {
00091     initInternal(1);
00092     internalUGens[0] = new PinkNoiseUGenInternal();
00093 }
